verdict.rationale: UCP is published as an open, industry-governed standard. Its "complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations" sit in a public GitHub repository, and a runtime probe confirmed ucp.dev/llms.txt serves a versioned spec index with dated releases (2026-08-25, 2026-04-08). Hands-on probes also showed a keyless, self-generated-profile client completing handshakes and creating a real cart, so the protocol can be implemented without credentials or agreements. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the spec's license terms (e.g., a named open-source license confirming no agreement is needed to implement it).
